n5f84f74c72d.s: Which Hampi temple is popularly known as the Saptaswara Devalayam?
n5f84f74c72d.x: Saptaswara Devalayam is the Vitthala temple; the Virupaksha temple is associated with Pampapati.

na408d098062.s: Which is regarded as the first and largest temple of Hampi?
na408d098062.x: The Virupaksha temple, on the Tungabhadra and dedicated to Shiva as Pampapati, is the first and largest temple of Hampi.

nfb26b8ed5e1.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Vijayanagara mural painting?
o: Mineral pigments such as ochre, green, black and white were used
The figures lacked movement and were rigidly proportioned
The paintings were executed on lime plaster
Bold dark outlines and flat colours were characteristic
nfb26b8ed5e1.x: Vijayanagara murals had elongated figures and energetic movement, so the claim that they lacked movement is false.

nb86bbde53eb.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Aravidu capitals of the Vijayanagara Empire?
o: Vellore was the first Aravidu capital
nb86bbde53eb.x: Penukonda (1570) was first, followed by Chandragiri and then Vellore (1600), so Vellore was the last, not the first.

new.s: In Vijayanagara architecture, the towering gateway that dwarfs the central shrine is the:
new.x: The Raya gopuram is the towering gateway that dwarfs the central shrine.

new.s: A separate goddess shrine in a Vijayanagara temple complex, as at Hazara Rama, is called the:
new.x: The Amman shrine is the separate goddess shrine, seen at the Hazara Rama temple.

new.s: Thousand-pillared halls with carved composite pillars in Vijayanagara temples are called:
new.x: Sahasra Stambha Mandapas are thousand-pillared halls with carved composite pillars.

new.s: Who described Vijayanagara architecture as the 'matured state of the Dravidian tradition'?
new.x: Percy Brown called it the matured state of the Dravidian tradition; Kramrisch surveyed Deccan painting.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Vijayanagara style:
1. Secular buildings were raised inside temple premises.
2. Pillared corridors were added to older temples.
3. The Ekapaadam was a Chola-type single pillar.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Secular buildings in temple premises and added pillared corridors were new; the Ekapaadam was a Hoysala-type pillar.

new.s: Which Hampi monument appears on the reverse of the Rs 50 note (Mahatma Gandhi New series)?
new.x: The Vittala stone chariot is on the reverse of the Rs 50 note.

new.s: The Tiruvengalanatha (Achyutaraya) temple at Hampi was set up in 1534 by which officer?
new.x: Achyutaraya's officer Hiriya Tirumalaraja set up the temple in 1534; Lakkana Dandesha enlarged Virupaksha.

new.s: In which year did Krishnadevaraya add the eastern gopuram of the Virupaksha temple at Hampi?
new.x: Krishnadevaraya added the eastern gopuram of the Virupaksha temple in 1510.

new.s: The Bala Krishna idol of the Krishna temple at Hampi was brought by Krishnadevaraya from:
new.x: Krishnadevaraya brought the Bala Krishna idol from the Udayagiri fort.

new.s: How many pillars did the Huzur Daftar (Diwan Khana) at Vijayanagara have?
new.x: The Indo-Persian Huzur Daftar had 40 pillars; 56 is the count of Vittala's musical pillars.

new.s: The Queen's Bath (Maharani Snanavatika) at Hampi stands near the:
new.x: The Queen's Bath is near the Lotus Mahal, in the zenana area.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the secular structures of Hampi?
o: The Lotus Mahal shows Indo-Islamic influence
The Huzur Daftar is an Indo-Persian council chamber
The Mahanavami Dibba was built by Krishnadevaraya for Dasara
The Lotus Mahal is credited to Achyutaraya
new.x: The Lotus Mahal is credited to Krishnadevaraya, not Achyutaraya.

new.s: On which hill does the Veerabhadra temple at Lepakshi stand?
new.x: The Lepakshi Veerabhadra temple stands on Kurma Shailam hill near Hindupur.

new.s: The three shrines of the Lepakshi temple complex are dedicated to:
new.x: Lepakshi has shrines of Shiva, Veerabhadra and Vishnu, each with a mukha mandapa.

new.s: The largest monolithic Nandi in India is at:
new.x: Lepakshi's monolithic Nandi is the largest in India (APPSC G2 2017).

new.s: The famous 'hanging pillar' is a feature of the temple at:
new.x: The hanging pillar is at Lepakshi (APPSC 2019).

new.s: The serpent over the Naga linga at Lepakshi has how many hoods?
new.x: The Naga linga is a linga under a seven-hooded serpent, carved from a single boulder.

new.s: The wall murals of Parvati Parinayamu and Tripurasura Samharam are found at:
new.x: Lepakshi's walls show Shiva themes such as Parvati Parinayamu and Tripurasura Samharam.

new.s: The presiding deity of the Ahobilam temples is:
new.x: Ahobilam's Upper and Lower temples are dedicated to Narasimha.

new.s: The Srikalahasti temple enshrines which linga?
new.x: Srikalahasti is the Vayu linga shrine.

new.s: The Bugga Ramalingeswara temple is located at:
new.x: Bugga Ramalingeswara is at Tadipatri, credited to the Pemmasani Nayakas.

new.s: The Chintala Venkataramana temple at Tadipatri was built by:
new.x: Pemmasani Timmanayudu built it in the mid-16th century.

new.s: Kadiri, an early centre of the Narasimha cult, has a temple of:
new.x: Kadiri's temple is dedicated to Narasimha.

new.s: High-relief sculpture (Ubattu Shilpalu) and the painting of Vatapatra Shayi are found at:
new.x: Tadipatri has Ubattu Shilpalu and the painting of Vatapatra Shayi.

new.s: The Tirumala Kalyana mandapam and bronze statues of the king with Chinnadevi and Tirumaladevi are credited to:
new.x: Krishnadevaraya added these at Tirumala; Harihara II built the Srisailam mukha mandapam.

new.s: Gooty (Gutti) fort was the base of:
new.x: Gooty was a stronghold and Aliya Rama Raya's base.

new.s: The Raja Mahal, a blend of Hindu and Indo-Saracenic styles, is at:
new.x: The Chandragiri fort has the Raja Mahal blending Hindu and Indo-Saracenic styles.

new.s: Which fort became the first Aravidu capital in 1570?
new.x: After Talikota, Penukonda became the first Aravidu capital in 1570.

new.s: Under Vijayanagara, the leather shadow puppet show Tolu Bommalata was the chief entertainment of:
new.x: Tolu Bommalata entertained rural people; Yakshaganam entertained the court (APPSC 2019).

new.s: Under Vijayanagara, the Vipra-Vinodins were:
o: Brahmin jugglers and actors for Brahmin households
new.x: Vipra-Vinodins were Brahmin jugglers/actors who performed for Brahmin households.

new.s: Under which dynasty did Yakshaganam become folk theatre and Kuchipudi flourish?
new.x: In the Qutb Shahi period Yakshaganam became folk theatre and Kuchipudi flourished under Golconda.

new.s: The first published Telugu Yakshaganam is:
new.x: Sugreeva Vijayam by Kandukuri Rudra Kavi is the first published Telugu Yakshaganam.

new.s: Veedhi Natakam, the street dance-drama of Andhra, is the forerunner of:
new.x: Veedhi Natakam / Veedhi Bhagavatam is the forerunner of Kuchipudi.

new.s: A Harikatha artist performs solo with which instrument?
new.x: Harikatha is a solo form with cymbals called Chidatalu; the burra belongs to Burrakatha.

new.s: Adibhatla Narayana Dasu, the Harikatha Pitamaha, was born at:
new.x: Adibhatla was born at Ajjada in Vizianagaram district; Pannekallu is Sheikh Nazar's birthplace.

new.s: In Rayalaseema, Burrakatha is called:
new.x: Burrakatha is known as Thandana Katha in Rayalaseema.

new.s: Besides Sheikh Nazar, which of the following popularised Burrakatha?
new.x: Burrakatha was popularised by Nazar, the Nittala Brothers and Bhadrakali.

new.s: The unique feature of Tolu Bommalata puppets is:
o: Performance in daylight without a screen
new.x: Tolu Bommalata's unique feature is moving the heads of the leather puppets behind a lit screen.

new.s: Which village of Anantapur is known for leather puppetry that received a GI tag in 2008?
new.x: Nimmalakunta (Anantapur) leather puppetry got the GI tag in 2008.

new.s: Vanarasa Govinda Rao, who replaced puppets with live actors in Keechaka Vadham, came from a family of:
new.x: The Surabhi founder came from a leather-puppet family, not Bhagavata Mela.

new.s: Oggu Katha is performed by the:
new.x: Oggu Katha belongs to the Golla/Kuruma shepherds; Asadi Katha is of the Madigas.

new.s: Asadi Katha narrates the story of:
new.x: The Asadi sub-caste of Madigas sing the story of Ellamma.

new.s: Chindu Bhagavatam is performed by the Chindu, a sub-group of the:
new.x: The Chindu, a Madiga sub-group of Telangana, perform the Chindu Bhagavatam.

new.s: Who founded Kuchipudi?
new.x: Siddhendra Yogi founded Kuchipudi; Tana Shah gifted the village.

new.s: The Bhagavata Mela, from which Kuchipudi grew, was a dance-drama of:
new.x: The Bhagavata Mela was a dance-drama of hereditary Brahmin families.

new.s: Dalavai Chalapathi Rao of Nimmalakunta, a Padma Shri awardee of 2020, is known for:
new.x: Dalavai Chalapathi Rao is a leather puppetry artist (Padma Shri 2020; National Award 1988).

new.s: Burrakatha artist Miriyala Apparao was awarded the Padma Shri (posthumous) in:
new.x: Miriyala Apparao received the Padma Shri posthumously in 2025.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about folk artists and their honours:
1. Adibhatla Narayana Dasu bears the title Harikatha Pitamaha.
2. Sheikh Nazar bears the title Harikatha Pitamaha.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Adibhatla is Harikatha Pitamaha; Sheikh Nazar is Burrakatha Pitamaha.

new.s: At the Undavalli Caves in July 2026, AP announced an annual Telugu Mahotsavam and the revival of:
new.x: Minister Kandula Durgesh announced the Telugu Mahotsavam and revival of Nandi Natakotsavams.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about folk forms of Andhra Pradesh:
1. In June 2025, Tholu Bommalata and Burrakatha were flagged as close to extinction.
2. Lack of patronage and youth disinterest are causes of their decline.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are true: these forms were flagged near extinction in June 2025, with lack of patronage and youth disinterest among causes.

new.s: World Folk Day is observed on:
new.x: World Folk Day falls on 22 August.

new.s: Kolatam kirtanas, sung for the group stick dance, were written by:
new.x: Annamacharya wrote the Kolatam kirtanas.

new.s: Sankranti songs and Gangireddulaata are associated with:
new.x: Sankranti songs and Gangireddulaata belong to the January harvest festival.

new.s: Tappeta Gullu, in which shepherds invoke rain and appease Gangamma, belongs to:
new.x: Tappeta Gullu is a dance of the north coastal districts.

new.s: Kolattam of Andhra is similar to which dance of Karnataka?
new.x: Kolattam corresponds to Jadakollu in Karnataka.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Puli Veshalu is the tiger dance of Vizianagaram Dasara; Keelugurram is of Guntur and Namala Singadu of Anantapur.

new.s: Garagalu dancers carry decorated pots on the head in honour of:
new.x: Garagalu dancers carry decorated pots on the head for the village goddess.

new.s: Which state cultural festival is held on the Beach Road and run by APTDC and VMRDA?
new.x: Visakha Utsav is held on Beach Road, Visakhapatnam, by APTDC and VMRDA.

new.s: The Rayalaseema Food and Dance Festival is held at:
new.x: The Rayalaseema Food and Dance Festival is held at Tirupati in October.

new.s: 'From Sea to Summit' was the theme of the 2026 edition of:
new.x: Visakha Utsav 2026 (24 Jan-1 Feb) had the theme 'From Sea to Summit'.

new.s: Lepakshi Utsav (Lepakshi Vaibhavam) showcases the heritage of:
new.x: Lepakshi Utsav showcases Rayalaseema heritage, dance and crafts.

new.s: Gangamma Jatara, a nine-day fair with men in women's attire, is held at:
new.x: Gangamma Jatara is held at Tirupati; Sirimanu belongs to Paidithalli of Vizianagaram.

new.s: The Mahanandi Shiva temple fair is held in which district?
new.x: Mahanandi is in Nandyal district.

new.s: The ancient Kotappakonda tirunallu is held in which district?
new.x: Kotappakonda is in the Guntur region, now Palnadu district.

new.s: Which temple town is called 'Dakshina Kasi'?
new.x: Draksharamam is Dakshina Kasi; Srikalahasti is Dakshina Kailasam.

new.s: 'Dakshina Kailasam' is the epithet of:
new.x: Srikalahasti is called Dakshina Kailasam.

new.s: Kondapalli toys are made from which light wood?
new.x: Kondapalli toys use the light Tella Poniki wood.

new.s: Budithi, known for GI-tagged bell and brass craft, lies in which district?
new.x: Budithi bell and brass craft is from Srikakulam district (GI 2008).

new.s: Pen (freehand) Kalamkari is associated with:
new.x: Srikalahasti Kalamkari is pen-drawn; Machilipatnam-Pedana is block-printed.

new.s: Udayagiri in Andhra Pradesh is known for:
new.x: Udayagiri is known for wooden cutlery (APPSC 2025); Narasapur is crochet.

new.s: Which of the following crafts belongs to Telangana and not Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Nirmal paintings, Bidri and Cherial scrolls are Telangana crafts.

new.s: Who headed the Sugandhabhandagara that supplied the Vasantotsavam?
new.x: Merchant Avachi Tippayashetti headed the Sugandhabhandagara (perfume store).

new.s: Kolla Pandalu (cockfights) are part of which festival?
new.x: Kolla Pandalu and Pottella Pandalu are part of the January Sankranti festival.

new.s: Bathukamma and Bonalu are identity festivals of:
new.x: Bathukamma and Bonalu are Telangana identity festivals.
